title: Tissue regeneration effect of betulin via inhibition of ROS/MAPKs/NF-kB axis using zebrafish model.
authors: Ouyang, Ting; Yin, Huafeng; Yang, Jianbo; Liu, Yue; Ma, Shuangcheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桦木醇通过ROS/MAPKs/NF-kB通路促进斑马鱼组织再生，分子对接仅针对小分子与炎症蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Betulin is the primary anti-inflammatory component of Betula platyphylla suk. cortex (birch bark), a time-honored Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) for healing trauma and tissue regeneration. However, the tissue regeneration effects and underlying molecular mechanism of betulin remain unknown. Therefore, it is necessary to investigate the wound repair effects and validate the mechanism of betulin in an appropriate model. In the present study, we evaluated the effects of tissue regeneration, melanin scavenging, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) inhibition of betulin using a zebrafish model. The mechanism of target genes and pathways were confirmed using quantitative polymerase chain reaction and western blotting in vivo, while molecular docking, absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity investigations in-silico were conducted. Betulin significantly promoted the regeneration of zebrafish caudal fin length and area and alleviated melanin aggregation, as well as ROS generation. The relative mRNA expression of IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, p38alpha, ERK1/2, and Caspase3, and the relative protein expression of p38alpha, ERK1/2, Caspase3, phosphorylated proteins of p-p38alpha, p-ERK1/2, and p-p65 were down-regulated following betulin administration. Meanwhile, the protein ratios of p-p38alpha/p38alpha, p-ERK/ERK, and p-p65/p65 were significantly decreased. In an in-silico study, binding affinities between betulin and P38alpha, ERK1, ERK2, and Caspase3, and the pharmacokinetic profile of betulin were predicted. The findings suggest that the tissue regeneration mechanism of betulin is based on the inhibition of excessive inflammatory responses, melanin aggregation, and the pro-apoptotic factor, Caspase3, during the proliferation phase via the ROS/MAPKs/NF-kB signaling axis. Our results suggest betulin as a potential candidate for tissue regeneration.
abstract_zh: 桦木醇是白桦（Betula platyphylla suk.）皮层（桦树皮）的主要抗炎成分，桦树皮是一种用于创伤愈合和组织再生的历史悠久的传统中药（TCM）。然而，桦木醇的组织再生效应及其潜在分子机制仍不清楚。因此，有必要在合适的模型中研究桦木醇的伤口修复效果并验证其机制。在本研究中，我们使用斑马鱼模型评估了桦木醇的组织再生、黑色素清除和活性氧（ROS）抑制作用。通过定量聚合酶链反应和蛋白质印迹法在体内确认了靶基因和通路的机制，同时进行了分子对接、吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性等计算机模拟研究。桦木醇显著促进了斑马鱼尾鳍长度和面积的再生，并减轻了黑色素聚集及ROS生成。桦木醇给药后，IL-1beta、TNF-alpha、p38alpha、ERK1/2和Caspase3的相对mRNA表达，以及p38alpha、ERK1/2、Caspase3、磷酸化蛋白p-p38alpha、p-ERK1/2和p-p65的相对蛋白表达均下调。同时，p-p38alpha/p38alpha、p-ERK/ERK和p-p65/p65的蛋白比值显著降低。在计算机模拟研究中，预测了桦木醇与P38alpha、ERK1、ERK2和Caspase3的结合亲和力以及桦木醇的药代动力学特征。研究结果表明，桦木醇的组织再生机制基于通过ROS/MAPKs/NF-kB信号轴在增殖阶段抑制过度炎症反应、黑色素聚集和促凋亡因子Caspase3。我们的结果提示桦木醇是组织再生的潜在候选药物。
